title: When two letters make one sound: sh, ch and th
examples: Why do two letters make one sound?

explain.say: Sometimes two letters make one sound. Look at the word ship. It has 4 letters. It has only 3 sounds.

draw.text: When two letters make one sound: sh, ch and th

explain.say: Look at s and h together. They make one sound, shh. It is the sound you make to ask for quiet. Put a finger on your lips and say it.
Now look at the other letters. The letter i makes the first sound in insect. The letter p makes the first sound in pig. Tap once for each sound: 3 taps. Then blend them to read ship.
Now c and h are together. They make the first sound in cheese. The word is now chip. Listen for the change from ship to chip.

Now t and h are together. They make the first sound in thumb. Put your tongue gently between your teeth and blow. The word is thin. In this and that, th uses your voice too. Today, look for sh, ch or th on a sign.

faq.a: A digraph is two letters that make one sound. Di means two, and graph means written. sh, ch and th are all digraphs.
Put a finger on your lips, like asking someone to be quiet, and push air out: shhh. It is the first sound in shop and ship.
It is the first sound in chip and cheese. It is a short sound, with a little puff of air.
Put your tongue gently between your teeth and blow, like at the start of thumb. In words like this and that, add your voice too.

faq.q: How do I spot letter teams when I read?
faq.a: Look for s, c or t with an h after it. Draw a line under the two letters, so you see them as one sound. A teacher or grown-up can help you look for them.
asks: How do I find sh in a word?

facts: The word ship has four letters but only three sounds.
In sh, ch and th, the letter h joins another letter to make a brand new sound.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word chip?
quiz.show: 🍟 How many sounds are in chip?
quiz.why: The letters c and h make one sound. Then come i and p, so chip has 3 sounds.

wrong.0: Tap again: ch is 1 sound, then i, then p.
wrong.2: Chip has 4 letters, but c and h make just 1 sound.

quiz.say: Listen to the word thumb. Which 2 letters make its first sound?
quiz.show: 👍 Which 2 letters make the first sound?
quiz.why: The letters t and h together make the first sound in thumb.

wrong.0: The letters s and h make the first sound in ship.
wrong.1: The letters c and h make the first sound in chip.
